name: Orbs of Warding
oracle_text:
You have hexproof. (You can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
If a creature would deal damage to you, prevent 1 of that damage.
blocked_sentences: If a creature would deal damage to you, prevent 1 of that damage.

needs.what: a player-wide static that prevents N of each damage event dealt to a seat (affects_player: you), narrowed by a damage_source filter on the dealer (types: [Creature]) -- absorb N for a player, keyed on the source's printed characteristics
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The 'prevent_damage' static reads only 'affects' (permanents) via characteristics.prevented_damage and never applies to damage dealt to a player, and takes no damage_source; 'prevent_all_but' reaches a seat but caps damage at N rather than subtracting N, and has no dealer filter; 'damage_source' is accepted only on 'replace_damage', whose damage_multiplier must be 2 or more
